name: Um Percurso, 10 Tesouros
description: Join a guided tour of Portugal's first public museum to uncover the stories behind ten of its most precious artistic treasures.
longDescription:
"Um Percurso, 10 Tesouros" offers a curated exploration of the Museu Nacional Soares dos Reis, Portugal's inaugural public museum. This guided art event focuses on revealing the narratives and historical significance embedded within ten selected masterpieces from the museum's extensive collection. The initiative aims to provide a deeper understanding of Portuguese art history and the cultural heritage preserved within this esteemed institution.

Participants will embark on a focused journey through the museum's galleries, led by an expert guide. The experience is designed to illuminate the context and artistic merit of each chosen treasure, fostering a closer connection between visitors and the works. The Museu Nacional Soares dos Reis, housed in a grand historic building, provides an atmospheric backdrop for this intimate encounter with art. The tour is conducted in Portuguese.

Admission to "Um Percurso, 10 Tesouros" is ticketed. The Museu Nacional Soares dos Reis is centrally located in Porto, a short walk from the Aliados metro station.
